note: Route A with Pressure for Help (Keel S25; Sky Q4): Inez is an Idealist, so Pressure works one step worse (+4 T, $0); the rest is route A. The cell runs where a player in a hurry would (to the café, the cabinet and the door): a run is noticed (Alert 1 at most), which the quiet route can afford.

steps.why: to the café terrace, where Inez can be watched
to wait beside the Office approach, out of the guard's cone

steps.label: reroute

steps.label: enter
steps.why: the first moment the door is unwatched: guard away, camera looped, patrol off its sweep
back to the getaway car to cover the extraction

the ambush: the armed cell fires at will

steps.label: out
steps.why: the last rival down: to the car
